entities.name: Lord Kazmyr
entities.description: Winged thrull, pet of kingpin Ilona, who repeatedly warns Symond that Bilagru will come.

entities.name: Ilona
entities.description: Kingpin whose thrull bears a noble name for her amusement.

entities.name: Symond Halm
entities.description: Playwright who signed a contract on his life and killed a vedalken to hide in an Azorius prison.

entities.name: Bilagru
entities.description: Entity said to come for Symond.

events.summary: Symond Halm signs a contract with Ilona that puts his life on the line if his play fails; Lord Kazmyr warns him Bilagru will come.
Symond's play launches with only a quarter of seats filled, and he bolts.
events.quote: only a quarter of the seats were filled

events.summary: Symond kills a vedalken man to be put into an Azorius prison.
events.quote: Symond killed a vedalken man to be put into an Azorius prison

events.summary: Bilagru goes to work in the prison as Lord Kazmyr keeps repeating his warning.

relations.note: He owes her a debt from her funding of his play.
relations.quote: he had to sign a contract that put his life on the line should he fail
